newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial climate cools in Oct - statoffice.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial climate cools in Oct - statoffice.

text.p: Poland's industrial climate in the manufacturing sector deteriorated in October and companies' expectations were less optimistic than in September, a monthly survey by the Central Statistics Office (GUS) showed.

GUS said on Thursday its industrial climate index for October fell four points to two points as companies forecasted dwindling demand and production, higher lay-offs in November and a decrease in the amount of due payments.

GUS said the worsening of the overall business climate was more pronounced among state-owned companies and bid firms, while small and privately-owned enterprises signalled a small improvement in the overall business climate in October.

It said the construction sector climate fell for the sixth month running, dropping eight points to 15 points as expectations about future orders worsened. Again state-owned companies were more pessimistic than private ones.
BUSINESS OUTLOOK OCT SEPT AUG JULY JUNE OCT 95
NOTE: The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies.
